claims: Ben McCollum is the head men’s basketball coach for the University of Iowa.
Ben McCollum was hired on March 24, 2025.
Ben McCollum's first season at the University of Iowa was 2025-2026.
Ben McCollum led the Hawkeyes to the Sweet 16 in the 2025-2026 season.
Ben McCollum won four Division II national championships at Northwest Missouri State
